baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُحَادُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ is followed by the repeated passive كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opponents take up a counter-position at a distinguishing limit and try to prevent or resist passage across it. كبت reverses that vector: the agents who set themselves against the limit are themselves driven back from their intended end with abasement.

activation_trace.role: The branch's distinguishing barrier gives المحادة a spatial-juridical edge and makes the opponents' stance a counter-boundary.
The explicit opposition branch supplies the social action enacted at that edge.
Driving an enemy away from its aim with abasement supplies the reversing force and explains the doubled historical wording.

changed_reading.before: They oppose God and His messenger and are defeated like earlier opponents.
changed_reading.after: They install themselves as a counter-boundary to God and His messenger, but their outward vector is reversed and they are driven from the very end they sought.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence رَسُولَهُۥ ... أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ... لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ links a sent carrier, delivered signs, disclosure, and covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: A communication moves outward through the messenger and downward through the delivered signs; those signs function as visible markers that disclose their meaning. كفر is therefore not mere lack of information but a counter-act of covering what the delivery has made available and manifest.

activation_trace.role: The carried message supplies the human transmission link opposed in the opening clause.
Causing something to arrive supplies the delivery event rather than a static possession of signs.
The visible marker makes each āyah an observable indicator within the delivery.
Disclosure through speech or sign supplies the signs' active clarifying work.
Blocking the truth supplies the answering counter-action: covering what the sign-delivery has disclosed.

changed_reading.before: Clear verses were revealed, yet the disbelievers rejected them.
changed_reading.after: A message has been made to arrive as visible, meaning-disclosing signs; kufr is the active re-covering of an already opened evidentiary channel.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two passive forms of كبت, the temporal مِن قَبْلِهِمْ, and the closing عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ form a repeated posture-and-status reversal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same event recurs across generations: an advancing or self-elevating opponent is cast face-down and rendered contemptible. The punishment is thus not only pain but an enacted contradiction of posture, force, and claimed standing.

activation_trace.role: Casting someone onto the face supplies the concrete downward posture behind the defeat.
Temporal precedence places the same reversal on an already traversed historical track.
Contemptuous abasement supplies the public status-loss paired with the bodily downward image.
The split mapping's weakness and insignificance sharpen humiliation as a loss of effective weight, not pain alone.

changed_reading.before: Earlier peoples were likewise disgraced, and the present disbelievers face a humiliating punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a recurrent inversion: those who stand hard against the message are put face-down and stripped of the standing their opposition asserted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening dispute is heard, processed, and answered through a remedial sequence that culminates in حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ. This distinguishes voiced contention inside an available hearing-and-remedy process from المحادة: the latter is resistance that hardens against the disclosed limit itself.

activation_trace.role: Audible reception supplies an open channel in which the woman's contested speech is not treated as opposition merely because it disputes.
The entwined contest supplies a difficult dispute that nevertheless remains heard and answerable.
The immediately preceding divine limits make the focus verb's counter-boundary image textually local and juridical.
The focus opposition branch anchors the revised distinction in يُحَادُّونَ rather than in dispute generally.
Forced redirection becomes the consequence of resisting the limit after a hearing-and-remedy route has been supplied.

structural_cues: 58:1 opens with a woman's dispute being heard rather than suppressed.
58:2-4 answer that dispute with correction and graded remedies, and 58:4 names them God's limits immediately before 58:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heard dispute, a remedial legal sequence, and the adjacent divine-limit/focus-opposition repetition. I infer that the juxtaposition differentiates contestable speech from hardened counter-position to the resulting limit; a live alternative is that 58:5 names hostility more broadly without this procedural threshold.

changed_reading.before: Muḥāddah is any forceful challenge or argument against divine authority.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits a grievance to become heard contention; muḥāddah is more specifically the counter-boundary formed against the clear limit after hearing and remedy remain possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: What actors consign to forgetfulness, secret counsel, or unvoiced inner saying remains enumerated and witnessed, then is reported back. Against this visibility asymmetry, the focus's clear signs become part of an audit architecture: disclosure defeats attempted informational cover before defeat becomes public humiliation.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies the retention mechanism by which no concealed act drops from the record.
Loss from human recollection supplies the failed erasure against which divine enumeration operates.
Presence with observation supplies the witness that closes the gap between private action and later disclosure.
Secret counsel supplies the concealed social channel that the audit mechanism penetrates.
Speech held within the self extends concealment from group counsel into unuttered interior assertion.
Visible markers anchor the audit reading in the focus verse's signs.
Manifest appearance supplies the transition from retained evidence to exposed evidence.

structural_cues: 58:6 follows the focus with resurrection, report, exhaustive retention, human forgetting, and universal witnessing.
58:7-8 move from private counsel to words said within selves while retaining the promise of later report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exhaustive retention, witness, and report around the focus's manifest signs. I infer an evidentiary arrow from retained private conduct to exposed humiliation; the live alternative is that the focus signs are only prior doctrinal proof and not part of the later audit imagery.

changed_reading.before: The clear signs are prior proof, while punishment is a separate consequence for rejecting them.
changed_reading.after: The clear signs inaugurate a regime of visibility in which secret, forgotten, and inward conduct remains countable and becomes disclosed; humiliation includes the collapse of informational cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive sequence opens space, rises on command, and is raised through degrees. It supplies the inverse axis for the focus sequence: rigid counter-position is cast face-down and loses rank. Humiliation is therefore legible as failed self-placement within a divinely controlled vertical and social ordering.

activation_trace.role: Opening spacious room supplies the yielding social posture opposite a rigid counter-boundary.
Rising and leaving one's place on command supplies obedient vertical movement rather than self-fixed standing.
Elevation of rank supplies the positive status outcome controlled by God.
Stepwise degrees give that status ordering a graded vertical form.
Being cast face-down supplies the focus verse's inverse bodily direction.
Contemptuous lowering converts the bodily inversion into loss of social rank.

structural_cues: 58:11 repeatedly pairs commanded spatial movement with God's reciprocal action.
The focus's face-down branch and humiliating close form a negative mirror of rising and being raised in degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit rise-and-raise sequence and the focus supplies a face-down abasement sequence. I infer that both inhabit one rank axis controlled by God; a live alternative is that the seating etiquette and the opponents' punishment are parallel only rhetorically, not mechanistically.

changed_reading.before: The punishment lowers the opponents in an undifferentiated sense.
changed_reading.after: Their lowering is the inverse of responsive social movement: those who yield place and rise when called are raised, while those who fix themselves against the limit are overturned and lose rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oaths are made into a protective cover from behind which actors redirect others away from the traversable path. The focus's covering, counter-boundary, and forced redirection now form a reciprocal topology: defensive cover enables obstruction, then obstruction rebounds as the obstructers are themselves driven back and their cover ends in humiliation.

activation_trace.role: A protective shield supplies the instrumental cover made from their oaths.
Turning away and redirecting supplies the outward obstruction performed from behind that shield.
The extended traversable path supplies the route whose flow the shielded actors interrupt.
Covering anchors the shield image in the focus's naming of the punished group.
Driving away from an aim reverses the direction the obstructers had imposed on others.
Humiliation is the shared terminal outcome that marks the protective strategy's failure.

structural_cues: 58:16 repeats the focus's exact closing phrase عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ.
The verse orders shield-making before path-blocking, supplying an explicit defensive means and obstructive end.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath-as-shield, redirection from a path, and the repeated humiliating outcome. I infer that the focus's كبت is a rebound of the obstructive vector and that kufr participates as strategic cover; a live alternative is that the repeated punishment links two offenses without specifying reciprocal mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is concealment of truth and humiliation is its later penalty.
changed_reading.after: Cover becomes operational: it is fashioned into protection for blocking a route, but the imposed redirection rebounds, strips the shield of efficacy, and drives its users from their own aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents exist inside nested force claims: seizure gathers and dominates them, yet the repeated muḥāddah formula places them among the broken-low, and the next verse fixes God's and His messengers' prevailing force as an obligatory outcome. كبت becomes the middle operation by which apparent captured power is subordinated to a written stronger vector.

activation_trace.role: Dominating seizure and gathering supply the opponents' immediate condition under a lesser controlling force.
Breaking under coercion supplies the explicit low-status result attached to the repeated opposition formula.
A written determination that obligates an outcome supplies certainty rather than a merely probable victory.
Overpowering force names the vector whose fixed outcome explains the focus's forced reversal.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the concentrated capacity behind that prevailing force.
Might after abasement creates a direct status contrast with the opponents' placement among the abased.
The focus's driving-back action is the operative reversal now explained by the later force sequence.

structural_cues: 58:20 repeats إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ from the focus and supplies the result فِى ٱلْأَذَلِّينَ.
58:21 immediately follows with a written first-person outcome: God and His messengers will prevail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies takeover, repeated opposition, abasement, written determination, and prevailing concentrated strength. I infer that كبت names the transition between competing force regimes; a live alternative is that these are separate descriptions of defeat without a nested-control mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The opponents happen to meet the same defeat that overtook earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent force already sits inside a stronger written order: كبت is the enacted overthrow that moves them from seized collective power to broken abasement under the guaranteed prevalence of God and His messengers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah relocates the focus's boundary into affiliation: affection is denied across active opposition even where lineage and clan exert their strongest pull. In place of inherited bonding, faith is fixed within hearts and reinforced by supporting power. The counter-boundary is thus social and affective as well as juridical or military.

activation_trace.role: Love and affection supply the relational flow that cannot be aligned with active opposition.
Filiation and descent supply one inherited bond placed under pressure by the opposition boundary.
Brotherhood and kinship broaden the tested attachment beyond direct descent.
The clan as a bonded group supplies the widest named social structure crossed by the allegiance boundary.
Binding inscription supplies the fixing of a new allegiance within rather than through inherited relation.
The heart supplies the interior site where that allegiance is established.
Supporting power supplies reinforcement against the pressure exerted by affection and kinship.
The focus's distinguishing limit anchors the social-affective separation in the verb of opposition.

structural_cues: 58:22 repeats the focus construction حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ inside a negated affection clause.
The verse then moves through fathers, sons, brothers, and clan before turning inward to faith written in hearts and reinforced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated affection across active opposition, a widening kin list, and inward inscription plus support. I infer that the focus boundary reorganizes allegiance and that inward reinforcement counters kin pressure; a live alternative is a narrower prohibition of loyal alliance during active hostility rather than a general affective topology.

changed_reading.before: Opposition to God and the messenger is chiefly an overt public or political stance.
changed_reading.after: The counter-boundary reaches the circuitry of belonging: active opposition tests affection and kin solidarity, while the answering alignment is written and reinforced inside the heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays the focus verb's iron-hard resistance with a non-dominant split mapping of ه و ن as ease or lightness. It remains anchored in packet-supplied branches for يُحَادُّونَ, كُبِتُوا۟, and مُّهِينٌۭ, but the ordinary humiliating sense remains primary; downstream prose should present this only as a material-status echo, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hard/iron branch of ح د د, the driving-back branch of ك ب ت, and the ease/lightness branch available under the split mapping of ه و ن converge within 58:5.

activation_trace.role: Iron-like resistant hardness supplies the opponents' self-presentation as difficult to move.
Forced redirection supplies the action that disproves the resistance of that hardness.
Ease and lightness supply an exploratory end-state in which the supposedly hard obstacle becomes easy to displace and of little weight.

changed_reading.before: Humiliation lowers the opponents' social standing after defeat.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, their iron-like counter-position is made light and easy to move; humiliation is the loss of the resistant weight they claimed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the restraint or weaning branch behind عذاب rather than its direct pain-and-penalty branch. It remains anchored by the focus's advance, driving-back, and punishment roots, and it explains a coherent deprivation mechanism; downstream prose should retain pain as the lexical center and qualify weaning as an exploratory account of what the punishment does to the opponents' aim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines historical advance or precedence in قَبْلِهِمْ, forced diversion in كبت, and an عذاب branch of restraint and weaning.

activation_trace.role: Advance and precedence supply the forward trajectory repeated across earlier and present opponents.
Driving the enemy from its desired end supplies the immediate interruption of that trajectory.
Restraint, prevention, and weaning supply the exploratory durative mechanism: punishment keeps the opposed agents from feeding their project or reaching its end.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is painful retribution after the opponents are defeated.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary mechanism, punishment is forced weaning from the opposed project: their advance is interrupted and they are deprived of the end that sustained it.

strongest_changes: The preceding heard dispute and named divine limits revise muḥāddah from mere argument into hardened counter-position against an available limit and remedy.
The post-focus sequence of counting, witness, secret counsel, and inner speech turns clear signs into an evidentiary visibility regime that defeats concealment.
The oath-shield and path-blocking sequence makes covering operational and lets كبت read as the rebound of an obstructive vector.
The repeated opposition formula, abasement, and written prevalence of God and His messengers make defeat a fixed force reversal rather than an isolated recurrence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's roots formed unusually concrete mechanics across domains: boundary, transmission, cover, posture, route, rank, force, and affiliation. Context did not collapse these into one gloss; it showed the same opposition being processed legally, evidentially, spatially, socially, and affectively.
remaining_uncertainties: The audit reading may describe the consequences of already-clear signs rather than expand what بَيِّنَٰتٍ itself does.
The vertical mirror with 58:11 is coherent but may be rhetorical contrast rather than a shared causal rank mechanism.
The hardness-to-lightness and punishment-as-weaning readings depend on mapped branch overlays and should remain exploratory rather than lexical replacements.
The final kinship reading may concern active loyal alignment specifically, not every form of affection toward an opponent.
